result.title: scBIG++: Learning Across Genes and Cells to Predict Single-Cell Perturbation Responses
result.summary: Predicting single-cell transcriptional responses to genetic and chemical interventions supports gene-function discovery and regulatory analysis. Existing studies often focus only on highly variable genes, restricting the expression changes available for downstream analysis. Cells exposed to the same intervention can also show heterogeneous expression responses, with coordinated gene programs active to different degrees. We propose scBIG++, a full-gene perturbation prediction framework that models this heterogeneity by connecting expression-adaptive gene modules with population-conditioned generation. To preserve shared gene structure while accommodating cellular variation, Gene-Relation Clustering organizes genes into common windows, within which Dynamic SoftSub learns expression-dependent submodule memberships. This shared organization enables Set-GCAE to exchange information about corresponding gene groups across control cells, placing individual representations in their source-population context. The cell representations initialize a latent flow, while their pooled summary and the perturbation representation condition response generation. Generated states are decoded into expression profiles covering all assayed protein-coding genes retained after preprocessing, supporting comprehensive analysis of perturbation-induced expression changes. Experiments across six genetic and chemical settings spanning 6,539--19,451 genes demonstrate competitive perturbation-effect recovery and full-gene expression reconstruction under unseen targets and combinations, cross-cell-line transfer, and held-out compounds. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/ttruan2426-dot/scBIG.

AI.brief_summary: scBIG++ 提出覆盖全部蛋白编码基因的单细胞扰动响应预测框架：用基因关系聚类与表达相关的动态软子模块刻画同一干预下的细胞异质性，在对照细胞间交换对应基因组信息，并以细胞表示初始化 latent flow、由池化群体摘要与扰动表示条件化生成表达谱，在六类遗传与化学扰动设定上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「共享结构 + 群体上下文条件化 latent flow」的做法，可能为 LVR 中如何用外部证据筛选、初始化并更新 latent 推理状态提供方法线索，但生成状态是否承载可复用的推理信息尚需核查。
